caption:
Most people know La Ventana for the wind.

From June through October, the wind steps back. The Sea of Cortez goes flat and warm — water temperatures in the mid-80s, visibility stretching 40 to 60 feet into the blue. Jacques Cousteau called it the world's aquarium. Once you are under the surface, you understand why.

Whale sharks drift near Espiritu Santo Island. Sea lions barrel-roll through the shallows at Los Islotes. Manta rays cruise the reef at Cerralvo. The same bay that fills with kite surfers in winter becomes one of Mexico's finest dive destinations by summer.

The Moroccan Palace sits five minutes from the water. Your stay, your pace — mornings on the pool terrace, afternoons in the Sea of Cortez.

Reserve your summer stay at themoroccanpalace.com
